sources.label: EDDMaps
sources.authority: University of Georgia Center for Invasive Species and Ecosystem Health
sources.caveat: Occurrence evidence only. Missing rows do not support absence or non-detection, and the legacy bounded merge cannot be subtracted safely without a full source-family rebuild.

sources.label: USGS NAS
sources.caveat: Spatial occurrence evidence only. Records vary in scale, completeness, population status, and temporal currency.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact canonical binomial agreement between the state plan, Project Isitusa catalog, and retained Darwin Core scientificName.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Exact NAS state code and explicit county-equivalent name must resolve to one active registered county equivalent. Missing, ambiguous, unknown, and retired geography is rejected. Coordinates are never used.

sources.label: USGS NAS occurrence API
sources.caveat: Targeted occurrence or collection evidence only. A zero-result query is a source screen, not absence.

sources.label: SERNEC
sources.authority: Southeastern Regional Network of Expertise and Collections
sources.caveat: Specimen occurrence evidence only. Collection coverage is not a complete inventory.

sources.label: EDDMapS ALIPC list
sources.authority: Alabama Invasive Plant Council and EDDMaps
sources.caveat: ALIPC membership selects targets; county occurrence still comes from EDDMaps.

sources.label: Alabama Plant Atlas
sources.caveat: County distribution based on documented plant records. Missing counties do not imply absence.

sources.label: Alabama Forestry Commission Cogongrass GIS
sources.caveat: Official program occurrence layer, not a complete county inventory.

sources.label: Alabama Forestry Commission Aerial Detection layer
sources.caveat: Detection evidence from observed features only. Unmapped areas are not absence.

sources.label: APHIS Emerald Ash Borer county layer
sources.authority: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
sources.caveat: Known-infested county evidence only.

sources.label: APHIS Federal Quarantine county layer
sources.authority: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service
sources.caveat: Active regulatory geography supports the named program condition, not broader abundance or county inventory.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact reviewed one-to-one mapping from an APHIS Quarantine_Program value to one Project Isitusa catalog species. Unmapped or ambiguous programs remain review-only and never publish.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Exact explicit five-digit Quarantine_County_FIPS plus matching APHIS state abbreviation and registered active county-equivalent name. Missing, mismatched, unknown, retired, and ambiguous geography is rejected. Coordinates and automatic successor crosswalks are never used.

sources.label: APHIS National Honey Bee Survey
sources.authority: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact APHIS varroa_per_100_bees metric to the Project Isitusa Varroa destructor catalog species. Missing, blank, negative, or nonnumeric metrics never create an assertion.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Exact explicit APHIS state_code and sampling_county_from_gps text must resolve uniquely through the active county-equivalent registry. Coordinates are never used to supply missing county identity.

sources.caveat: Zero-count rows support sample-level non-detection only, never countywide absence.

sources.label: USFWS invasive carp eDNA sample layer
sources.caveat: An exact No eDNA detected sample supports survey-area non-detection for Bighead and Silver Carp only. It does not establish countywide absence, and positive eDNA is not treated as verified presence.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact canonical binomial mapping to the official Bighead Carp and Silver Carp eDNA program targets. Only the exact No eDNA detected label is eligible; positive labels, No detection data, blanks, and source silence never publish.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Source-specific coordinate exception: Coordinate-derived county assignment: all retained USFWS source coordinates resolved uniquely to the declared active county using the committed canonical Census county-equivalent topology and a matching source state. The assertion must retain the topology path and SHA-256 plus the exact source-coordinate count and coordinate-set SHA-256; ambiguous, offshore, multi-county, invalid, and source-state-mismatch rows are ineligible.

sources.label: Laurel Wilt public county layer
sources.caveat: Public detection layer evidence only.

sources.label: USFS Alien Forest Pest Explorer
sources.authority: USDA Forest Service and Purdue University
sources.caveat: County detection compilation. The retained v1.0 snapshot uses underlying data last updated in April 2023 and is stale for current-source readiness. Missing values and binary zero cells do not establish absence or non-detection.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact versioned mapping from one published AFPE DCA column and dictionary label to one reviewed Project Isitusa catalog species. Only the 13 hash-pinned mappings are authorized.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Exact five-digit source FIPS must match one active county equivalent. The source county label must normalize to that exact-FIPS target name, but label ambiguity alone does not override an exact FIPS. Retired, abolished, superseded, missing, unknown, and out-of-scope FIPS are rejected without automatic crosswalks. Coordinates are never used.

sources.label: USDA Forest Service FIA DataMart invasive plant tables
sources.authority: USDA Forest Service Forest Inventory and Analysis
sources.caveat: Plot detections support occurrence at sampled locations. Missing detections are source silence only and never countywide absence or survey non-detection.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Each state-listed FIA symbol must resolve through the hash-pinned plant dictionary to exactly one catalog scientific name. Multiple exact source symbols may converge on one catalog species and are collapsed at the county-species pair level. Ambiguous and unmatched symbols never publish.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Explicit FIA STATECD plus zero-padded COUNTYCD must match one active county equivalent. Coordinates and automatic retired-geography crosswalks are prohibited.

sources.label: USFS Current Invasive Plant Locations
sources.caveat: Occurrence evidence is limited to represented Forest Service lands.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: The retained provider accepted scientific name must exactly match one requested Project Isitusa catalog scientific name after whitespace and case normalization. Missing, genus-only, ambiguous, changed, or unmatched names are rejected.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Source-specific positive polygon witness: at least one coordinate from each accepted retained full source polygon lies inside the committed active county topology. Bbox-center estimates only select candidates and never publish. Missing geometry, no inside-county vertex, retired geography, and ambiguous geography are rejected.

sources.label: USDA Forest Service Insect and Disease Survey point detections
sources.caveat: Point detections support occurrence only at surveyed detections.

sources.label: USDA NRCS PLANTS county distribution
sources.caveat: County distribution documentation supports occurrence. Missing counties do not imply absence.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact committed PLANTS master ID, accepted profile, symbol, scientific name, L48 Introduced profile status, and stable Introduced/Both layer-6 establishment fingerprint. The misleading layer-6 Symbol field is establishment text, not the plant symbol; profile and CSV fields remain the plant-symbol authorities. Drift or ambiguity blocks the taxon.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Exact provider CSV two-digit state FIPS plus three-digit county FIPS, matching current registry state and county names. Missing, mismatched, retired, conflicting, and ambiguous geography is rejected. MapServer cross-layer IDs, coordinates, and automatic successor crosswalks are prohibited.

sources.label: GBIF preserved specimen records

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Strict GBIF species match with EXACT match type, confidence at least 95, and exact canonical binomial agreement.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Explicit source state and county-equivalent text must resolve uniquely to the requested active state and county-equivalent registry entry. Retired, missing, ambiguous, and coordinate-only geography is rejected.

sources.caveat: Preserved specimen evidence only. Publisher records can contain taxonomic and geospatial issues.

sources.label: GBIF coordinate-resolved preserved specimen records
sources.caveat: Coordinate-derived county specimen evidence only. Quality flags and boundary resolution remain material.

sources.label: GBIF Invasive Plant Atlas of the MidSouth records
sources.authority: Invasive Plant Atlas of the MidSouth via GBIF
sources.caveat: Dataset-specific observation evidence only.

sources.label: GBIF eBird Observation Dataset
sources.authority: Cornell Lab of Ornithology via GBIF
sources.caveat: Observation evidence only. Checklist non-reporting is not absence.

sources.label: iDigBio preserved specimen records

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact canonical binomial agreement across normalized iDigBio taxon terms and retained provider scientific name, with ambiguous taxon flags rejected.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Explicit normalized source state and county-equivalent text must match the requested active registry entry. Retired, missing, ambiguous, and coordinate-only geography is rejected.

sources.caveat: Historical preserved specimen evidence from the iDigBio search index, officially frozen as of 2026-05-08. Aggregated records may overlap GBIF and collection portals, and missing records never support absence or non-detection.

sources.label: iNaturalist Research Grade observations
sources.caveat: Community-reviewed occurrence evidence only. Research Grade and taxonomy can change.

sources.label: Water Quality Portal biological results
sources.caveat: Positive biological results support sampled occurrence. Zero or missing rows require explicit protocol review.

sources.label: USGS North American Breeding Bird Survey route-start detections
sources.caveat: Route-start detections are sampled occurrence evidence, not countywide inventory.

researchAdapter.taxonMatchingPolicy: Exact current-catalog binomial agreement with the hash-pinned BBS SpeciesList.csv row and exact AOU code. Unmatched and ambiguous catalog birds never publish.
researchAdapter.geographyMatchingPolicy: Source-specific positive route-start witness: every retained BBS route-start coordinate resolved inside exactly one committed active county polygon and matched the requested state. The assertion must retain the topology path and SHA-256 plus the exact source-coordinate count and coordinate-set SHA-256. Only positive standard-run Stop 1 detections are eligible; later stops, route totals, unresolved or ambiguous coordinates, retired geography, and state mismatches are prohibited.

sources.label: NEON TALL plant presence and percent cover
sources.caveat: Plot evidence is limited to sampled NEON locations.
